headline: Oil Hits Six-Month Highs Amid Hormuz Attacks and Iran Tensions
summary: Oil prices reached six-month highs as attacks in the Strait of Hormuz threaten peace efforts involving Iran.
why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity and energy input whose price movements directly impact inflation, transport costs, and energy sector equities worldwide.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Attacks threatening supply routes in the Strait of Hormuz drive up global crude oil prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Supply disruption risks in the critical Strait of Hormuz shipping lane raised concerns over oil availability, driving prices to six-month highs.
